gap: No result ChatGPT got says how much power the timer plug uses while it sits idle. Community measurements in the Home Assistant Powercalc library put the Kasa EP10 at 0.58 W and the Kasa KP125M at 0.475 W, which is about 4–5 kWh a year for each plug.
standout_why: I read the two cited rivals, tp-link.com/us/support/faq/947 (Kasa schedule, away mode and timer) and tapo.com/us/faq/83 (Tapo schedule, timer and auto-off). Both only explain how to set up schedules, countdowns and auto-off. Neither gives any measured figure or even the most schedules a plug can hold. The top uncited result, itechguides.com's 2026 smart plug roundup, also has no measurements. It lists only maker load ratings (15 A, 1,800 W) and prices, and credits 'hands-on testing' to PCMag, WIRED, Engadget and T3 without any numbers. timerone.com would not load because of a certificate error. So an idle-draw figure is new. It is not decisive: the figures come from named individual contributors, not a magazine lab, and there is no matched figure for the Tapo P125M or the Defiant plug.
decides: It supports the pick rather than changing it. A timer plug stays plugged in all year, and the measured idle draw of about 0.5–0.6 W (about 4–5 kWh a year) is too small to separate the Kasa candidates. The EP10 (0.58 W) and the energy-monitoring KP125M (0.475 W relay off) are about the same. Choose on timer features instead: Tapo's FAQ lists auto-off for all Tapo plugs but only the EP40M, KP125M and EP25 V2 among Kasa models, so it excludes the EP10. For this question, I found no named lab measurement of latency or timer accuracy that would change the ranking.

Response time and latency for any candidate: TechRadar's P125M review page came back cut off after the headline, Wirecutter's smart plug guide (nytimes.com) cannot be fetched, and TechHive's EP10 review returned 410 Gone.
A named test of timer or schedule accuracy, or of schedules running with the internet down: I found only TP-Link community forum posts from users and staff, with no test method or figures.
